item.title: Iran backlash forces Gulf allies toward Washington as regional tensions rise
item.summary: Saudi Arabia reportedly granted U.S. forces access to King Fahd Air Base for the first time since the Gulf War as Gulf states recalibrate their posture amid escalating Iranian attacks.

item.title: NASCAR driver Denny Hamlin's mother makes heartbreaking plea to county officials after deadly house fire
item.summary: Mary Lou Hamlin, mother of NASCAR driver Denny Hamlin, made an emotional plea for fire department funding after a deadly North Carolina house fire killed her husband.

item.title: Sheridan Gorman's university newspaper touts ICE tracker after freshman allegedly murdered by illegal alien
item.summary: Loyola Phoenix still runs an ICE tracker after DHS says freshman Sheridan Gorman was allegedly killed by an illegal immigrant released under Biden.

item.title: ‘Lovers’ Lane’ murders suspect nabbed decades after couple found dead in car
item.summary: Floyd William Parrott is charged with capital murder in the 1990 'Lovers' Lane' cold case killings of two Texas victims after 36 years unsolved.

item.title: FBI says 'malicious actors' targeted Patel's personal email, Iran-based hacking group claims responsibility
item.summary: The FBI says “malicious actors" targeted Director Patel’s personal email, adding the information exposed was historical and not government-related.

item.title: House conservatives rage against Senate DHS shutdown deal
item.summary: House Freedom Caucus threatened to block the Senate DHS funding deal, demanding full-year ICE and CBP funding plus voter ID requirements in the bill.

item.title: Secret Service agent assigned to Jill Biden injured in 'negligent discharge' at Philadelphia airport
item.summary: A U.S. Secret Service agent was injured "following a negligent discharge while handling a service weapon" according to a Secret Service spokesperson.

item.title: Viral interview captures what traveler really thought about ICE agents helping TSA at airports
item.summary: Brooklyn man Chris Scali went viral after praising ICE agents at Newark Airport, saying their presence was just "common sense" as the DHS shutdown played out.

item.title: DarkSword leak puts millions of iPhone users at risk
item.summary: A leaked hacking tool called DarkSword could expose older iPhones and iPads to attacks through malicious links and compromised websites.

item.title: Obama-appointed judge reverses course, rules voter ID law isn't discriminatory in GOP win
item.summary: Judge Loretta Biggs, an Obama appointee, ruled North Carolina's voter ID law constitutional after a seven-year court fight, a major Republican win.
